She’s in the Glow  
Born in Zürich, 2026.

An Alpine State of Mind.

Distinctive alpine wear with a feminine point of view. Born in Zürich, She’s in the Glow brings a fashion sensibility to life in the mountains, pairing considered silhouettes with alpine functionality.

From first tracks to long lunches on sunlit terraces, each collection moves between ski, après-ski and the pleasures of getting away.

For the snow. For the mountains. For a life beautifully lived.

Ski & Après-Ski · Resort & Chalet

Go where you feel alive.
